name: Adam Bielan - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the changing geopolitical situation in East Asia and the need for closer cooperation with like-minded partners in the region
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the Council, the Commission and the EU's foreign policy chief to pay much more attention to East Asia. It wants closer ties with Japan, South Korea and Taiwan on trade, defence technology, computer chips, undersea cables and cybersecurity. It also wants the EU to speak out against coercion and military pressure in the region, especially around Taiwan and the South China Sea, and to keep talking to China. This is a recommendation, so it does not change any law.

- The EU is urged to deepen security, trade and technology cooperation with Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.
- It affects EU foreign policy, trade deals, chip and defence supply chains, and research links.
- Next, the Council, Commission and foreign policy chief decide whether to act on these requests.
